claim_assessment.description: 156 test cases, 78 client and 78 server, including 61 mirrored pairs
claim_assessment.evidence: Test definitions and pair mapping have exactly 156 IDs and 61 disjoint mirrored pairs.
claim_assessment.limitation: Census verifies the artifact, not every excluded MUST, SHOULD or TLS rule.

claim_assessment.evidence: 15 published proxy rows compared with exact counts under the authors classifier.
claim_assessment.limitation: Reanalysis of archived author measurements; counts are not independent fresh physical replication. Rejection is not equivalent to RFC compliance.

claim_assessment.description: Vectorized behavior differs by proxy and test identity
claim_assessment.evidence: All per-test author vectors and Table5 aggregates reproduced; PDF raster cells are not fully independently checked.
claim_assessment.limitation: Individual plotted raster cells not automatically verified against the PDF. Evidence-preserving recoding shown separately.

claim_assessment.evidence: Ten published client/server ratios independently transcribed from Figure 5; comparisons retain 78-case denominators.
claim_assessment.limitation: Paper broad E/G/R rule and ignore-to-drop rule reproduced; response scope/code and timeout causes need separate evidence.

claim_assessment.description: Behavior discrepancy over 61 explicitly paired test identities
claim_assessment.evidence: Published percentages compared within 0.05 percentage points for one-decimal rounding. Unknown pairs reported separately.
claim_assessment.limitation: Behavior discrepancy is descriptive, not evidence that code paths are redundant or a causal diagnosis.

claim_assessment.description: Historical versions change the distribution of protocol behaviors
claim_assessment.evidence: Nine checked prose deltas agree, but Traefik dropped delta is +90 in currently released raw data versus published +12. Stored author output gives +12.
claim_assessment.limitation: Artifact/output inconsistency unresolved; stale summary or configuration drift are hypotheses. No causal attribution to RFC revision.

claim_assessment.description: H2H1 downgrade changes client-side behavior relative to H2EE
claim_assessment.evidence: Controlled accepted-to-accepted fixture exposes bar generator misclassification. Published accepted deltas Envoy8, HAproxy5, Nghttpx5, H2O2; corrected matched deltas6,-1,1,1.
claim_assessment.limitation: The released code diagnoses numerical category mapping; it does not demonstrate exploitability or reconstruct historic deployments.

claim_assessment.description: No TLS versus plaintext behavioral differences
claim_assessment.evidence: Released TLS datasets are available for exact identity comparison.
claim_assessment.limitation: Unlabeled cleartext/TLS configurations cannot be assumed equivalent; observation from one deployment is not a universal layering guarantee.

claim_assessment.description: None of the studied proxies is fully compliant
claim_assessment.evidence: Broad author scores and evidence-preserving outcomes retained; acceptance and dropped categories require case-level semantics.
claim_assessment.limitation: Finite suite cannot establish full compliance. Error scope/code, modified messages and legitimate ignore rules require RFC interpretation.

claim_assessment.description: HTTP/2 proxies are stricter than prior HTTP/1.1 tests
claim_assessment.evidence: Published comparison is 1745/1950 rejected versus 128/564 HTTP/1.1. Appendix A maps eight prior case IDs into 23 current IDs.
claim_assessment.limitation: Different case universe, roles and versions prevent a matched causal improvement estimate; rejection includes silent drops.

claim_assessment.evidence: Paper Section2.1 says12bytes; its Table1 depicts72bits. RFC9113 4.1 requires9octets. Fresh independent raw-frame loopback controls send and parse9octet headers.
claim_assessment.limitation: Expository unit/count error does not by itself invalidate the measurement campaign.

claim_assessment.description: Independent physical replication of all local and cloud proxy deployments
claim_assessment.evidence: Published local setup is Ubuntu 24.10 VMs on one hypervisor; cloud workers are Frankfurt and Melbourne Linode nodes on 2025-05-07.
claim_assessment.limitation: Those historical deployments, cloud internal versions and geographic paths cannot be recreated exactly. Fresh loopback pilot will be separate.

claim_assessment.description: TCP sequence matching confirms absence of transparent proxies
claim_assessment.evidence: Matching numbers exclude some TCP-splitting implementations.
claim_assessment.limitation: Does not exclude passive devices, non-splitting intermediaries, all path variants or TLS-layer intervention.

claim_assessment.description: Normative formal RFC compliance suites improve clarity/security
claim_assessment.evidence: Recommendation motivated by observed diversity and directly cited security literature.
claim_assessment.limitation: No randomized developer study, intervention, exploit reproduction or measured interoperability benefit.
